messages:
Aisha (Finance): Heads up — QuotaLoop renewal lands in ~6 weeks. They sent a proposed amendment that converts us from a seat+overage model to pure usage-based billing. PDF attached: https://quotaloop.example/quote/QL-2026-03.pdf. Can we align on negotiation asks?

Marco (Procurement): Quick notes: 1) ask for a graduated pricing tier (so heavy months don't blow the budget), 2) request a 12-month committed spend discount or a blended rate for the term, 3) insist on separate line items for embeddings vs generation tokens, 4) push for a migration credit to cover unused seats if we convert.

Lina (DevOps): FYI our usage pattern is embeddings-heavy for search + nightly bulk indexing. We get big spikes during release smoke tests and marketing campaigns. If they go pure usage, we need burst protection or a throttled cap so one campaign doesn't cause an outage or huge bill.

Evan (Engineering): Can we ask QuotaLoop to define how they meter tokens precisely? Are embeddings counted as tokens or as a separate API call? Also request their rounding rules (per-request, per-token, per-1k tokens). Small differences change cost by ~25% on our dataset shape.

Aisha (Finance): Good calls. Also want clarity on invoice cadence and granularity: we need a line-by-line invoice that splits features (embeddings, generation, fine-tuning, enterprise support). We need PO-friendly lines and a single invoice PDF per month.

Marco (Procurement): Suggested negotiation targets to propose to QuotaLoop: - 20–25% renewal discount if we commit to 12 months or a $Xk committed spend. - Cap monthly overage at +20% of committed spend unless approved. - Embedding unit price no higher than Y% of generation token price (specify numbers after Evan confirms meter rules). - 60-day termination with prorated refunds for pre-paid commits and migration credit for unused seats.

Lina (DevOps): Also ask for a test/dev allowance or non-prod pool with 50% discount for spike testing. We need this for perf validation.

Evan (Engineering): Add an ask for separate usage reporting CSV with fields: date, product, endpoint, usage_units, rounding_rule, project_tag. We can automate cost mapping if we get that.

Aisha (Finance): If Procurement is comfortable, propose we ask for: 1) a 20% discount on list with 12-month commit, 2) explicit invoice separation (embeddings/generation/support), 3) monthly usage CSV + API, 4) burst cap + test/dev pool. Sound reasonable? :thinking_face:

Marco (Procurement): Sounds good. I'll draft the email with those asks + a short fallback: if vendor refuses tiers, we ask for a 3‑month price guarantee and a commitment credit for seats moved to usage.

FinanceBot: Reminder — draft PO and budget approval needed by 2026-03-31 to lock renewal rate. Current renewal window: 2026-04-15.

Aisha (Finance): Okay Marco — please draft and drop the email in this thread by EOD tomorrow. I'll pre-clear the budget ask with Finance Ops once we have the vendor response. I'll also book a 30m negotiation call for next week if they accept the terms in principle.

Marco (Procurement): Will do. Draft will include concrete numbers for the commit and a sample invoice template request. Putting it on my to-do list now :+1:

Evan (Engineering): One more — ask them to confirm data residency for embeddings storage (EU/US zones) and if they support customer-managed KMS for any stored artifacts. Security will need that before renewal.

Aisha (Finance): Adding that to the email checklist. Thanks all — will follow up after Marco posts the draft.
